label_rationale: check fails on the workflows that install wrote, after a move of the pin.
summary: Since Dependabot moved the pin of the issue assistant to v1.2.2, `check` says that issue-assistant.yml and issue-lifecycle.yml differ from the template.
analysis: A release that changes a template needs `install` again: a move of the pin alone keeps the workflows of the earlier release, which `check` compares with the templates of the new one. labels.yml and findings.yml still pass, so v1.2.2 probably changed only the other two.
next_steps: Run `install` of v1.2.2 again and commit the workflows that it writes.
missing_information: The link to the failed run of `check`.
